new_findings: Unchanged K-3 II decoded bytes repack byte-identically to the original distribution package.
Primary 16 MiB checksum is little-endian at 0x1f0; secondary 0xf000-byte checksum is big-endian at 0x100007c.
Original decoder 0x8476cc agrees with the Python transform over the complete two-image package.
Command-7 sender 0x599fb8 and receiver 0xda078/0xda248 exchange a 32-bit additive sum. Sequential original CPU contexts reproduced the mailbox reply without supplying completion or result values.
A repaired checksum also accepts intentionally corrupted secondary code, demonstrating that structural acceptance does not prove program correctness.
Capability response 0x8205 writes CLensKaf2+6 only on transport success; original CAfLens bit-6 predicate drives both CAfMotor branches.
Six original AF cases distinguish bit 6, bit 7 and retained prior values on failure; three native model-profile dispatch cases also reproduce.
Auxiliary updater sends 960 chunks of 64 bytes then reads 0xf000 bytes into a separate trailing buffer; only content mismatch retries, up to three total attempts.
Original RAM copy relocates 0xb324..0xb950 to VA 0x40304000; original mailbox command 8/9/A/C sender and receiver contexts reproduce.
Command-A receiver discards native program result 2 and acknowledges with a zero result slot. The upper controller independently tests content again after a zero program reply.
PEF=0 and DNG=1 selection changes pending state; seven apply events write setting 0x97 to the selected RAM live/mirror bank, while cancellation restores cached state.
Original type-4 resource lookup constructs text objects with locale pointer +0x90 and style +0x84; twelve native glyph-preparation cases reproduce.
Actual update entry after auxiliary success calls the relocated sector pass with arguments (2,0); variant 0 skips sectors 13..22 and writes sector 0 last.
Actual update retries a failed sector pass up to 16 times; alternate variant 1 ignores the first special-sector return before the second call.

Independent review found computed checksum FFFFFFFF could select the native bypass. Commit 9521f68 rejects this value in both endian sections before export; native sentinel comparison and regression tests pass.
Original capability query requires status bit 6 and a zero cache; body/lens control fixtures inherit the original cached response.
Two original ITCM application slices share the same motor object and pass a calculated 16-bit request to the original drive-preparation split with argument 8.
Lens command 0x8211 returns two big-endian bytes; under an explicitly supplied error-without-reply-update boundary, the caller uses the previous word.
Color Space parent widget0x0140B043/action0x1D requests detail0xB4. Original detail settings map sRGB0/AdobeRGB1 to key0x15C; eight lifecycle cases reproduce.
Every confirmed color-space case performs exactly one live and one mirror byte store, including same-value confirmation. Cancel3 leaves the pending byte until reopen reloads persisted RAM.
Preserved sectors13/22 hold settings copies. Original config binding points its mirror at0x404A4F20; two other staged regions include a generation counter.
Metadata selection and main-marker fallback are independent. The save controller uses metadata selector+0x2CB for source/target even when main selector+0x2CC differs.

Same-value color setting causes two RAM stores but no sector request. Changed values stage three RAM blocks, increment metadata and request the metadata-opposite sector; 29 bounded storage cases reproduce.
C reconstruction of tone leaf0x4DD3EC..0x4DD42C compiles to64-byte A32 text with Zig0.17.1/Clang22.1.8, no text relocation or undefined symbols.

Original and rebuilt runs match2304 calls at9 original sites and2048 outputs,33 direct cases and268288 numeric outputs plus2 application cases. r3-r12/SP/LR/A32 and exact direct table reads are checked.
Input0x3FC1 returns original Z1 versus rebuilt Z0. Three observed loops execute their own CMP before conditional backedges; full CPU-state equivalence is not claimed.
Return-time r3/r12 poison controls fault in original caller memory accesses, proving these registers must be preserved for the observed callers despite generic AAPCS scratch allowances.
